videos.desc: A woman on her own at home. She sings into a hairbrush and dances around her empty living room in a big jumper. Then she sits at a table with a whole pepperoni pizza in front of her and one lit candle, and takes a bite straight from the slice. Finally she carries the pizza box through to her bedroom and lies back across the bed by herself, smiling.

A woman in a mustard jumper stands at a white wall next to a window with a big photo calendar hanging on it. She uncaps a red marker, leans in and draws a red ring around one number in the grid, grinning at it. She then scribbles a large cross over the ringed number, and finally turns to the camera beaming and points at the marked day with her finger.

A rainbow-coloured twin-bell alarm clock stands on a bedside table showing almost ten o'clock, with someone asleep in the bed behind it. The man screws up his face against the pillow. Next he stands in his kitchen holding a striped mug, hair everywhere, staring straight ahead in horror under a big round wall clock. Then a woman in a navy suit and heels stops in the middle of a grand glass-roofed shopping arcade, checks her wristwatch under the huge station clock on the end wall, and runs off through the crowd.

Early morning in a kitchen with low sun through the window. A woman in a cream dressing gown yawns behind her hand and reaches up into the cupboard above the coffee machine, then leans in over the paper filter. She then props her chin on both hands right beside the machine and watches the glass jug, waiting, while the coffee drips in slowly. When the jug is full she lifts it and pours a long stream of dark coffee into a big painted mug, then holds the mug in both hands, closes her eyes and drinks.

A woman in blue medical scrubs comes home through her front door at the end of a shift, hanging her keys in a bowl. She yawns hugely with her eyes screwed shut, peels off her grey jacket and drops her bag, yawning again and rubbing her face with her hand. She staggers to the sofa and drops onto it sideways, and the clip ends with her lying asleep on the cushions with her eyes closed and her phone beside her.

A woman in a cream jumper and jeans is seated alone in a padded seat in an empty auditorium, blowing out a breath. As the camera pulls back, more and more people are seated in the rows around and behind her, until the whole vast hall is full of people sitting quietly in their seats, all facing the same way.

A young man in a denim apron works the griddle of an American diner with red booths behind him. He cracks an egg onto the hot plate beside frying eggs and pancakes, flips the pancakes with a spatula, and stacks them on a green-rimmed plate. Syrup is poured over a pat of butter on top of the stack. He then leans over the counter, eyes wide, and strikes the metal service bell with his palm to call the order away.

An older woman in a yellow cardigan carries a big armful of clean laundry across a bright room, opens a tall white cupboard and pulls out a folding ironing board. She sets it up on the wooden floor, spreads its patchwork cover flat, then works through the pile with a steam iron and holds up a finished pale blue shirt.

Early light over an empty paved plaza: a person in a mustard coat stands at the edge with a flock of grey birds pecking in front of them, then the birds lift off low across the stones. Inside a deserted station hall the same person stands alone at the foot of a bank of escalators under the bright ceiling lights. They sit by themselves on a long empty row of seats with a canvas bag beside them, sipping from a can. In the last shot they stand in the middle of a wide boulevard, alone on the white stripes of the crossing with no traffic at all, while the sun comes up between the buildings and the trees behind them.

A woman opens a big double-door fridge and finds it almost bare, with only one jar of pickles on a shelf. Then hands start placing food inside: an apple onto a glass shelf, a bag of lettuce and cucumbers onto the shelf below, jars and a juice carton into the door racks. At the end she steps back in front of a fridge packed with fruit, vegetables, milk and juice and her mouth falls open.

A close shot shows a blue-and-white tube squeezing a stripe of pale blue paste onto the bristles of a small green-and-white brush. A young man in blue pyjamas then stands at the bathroom mirror scrubbing his front teeth with it and working it around his mouth. He bends over the basin, rinses with water from his cupped hand and spits, then straightens up, smiles at his reflection and stands the brush in a white cup beside the tap.

A brightly painted bunk room at a summer camp with open windows onto trees. A teenage boy on a top bunk jolts out of sleep with his eyes wide and his mouth open, then sits up and rubs his face with both hands while another child still lies asleep on the bunk below. The camera moves across the room and the whole dormitory comes out of sleep: children push back their duvets, sit up on the edges of their bunks and rub their eyes, with sandals and flip-flops on the floor beside the beds.

A short montage of things being washed. First two hands scrub a white plate with a sponge under a running kitchen tap. Then a jet of water sprays the front of a dark car on a driveway. Then a hand lifts a pale shirt out of a big metal tub filled with white suds. Then a woman kneels on a lawn laughing while she washes a golden retriever sitting in a large grey plastic tub of water. Finally a group of people soap up cars at a car wash in a car park.

A young couple's morning at home. She stands at the stove in his oversized blue shirt, flipping a pancake in a frying pan while he dances up behind her in a white shirt and tie. She then turns to him, holding a big mug of coffee, and carefully straightens the knot of his tie against his collar until it sits right. Later they kneel at a low table in the living room holding hands over two slices of cake, and finally they flop onto the sofa laughing, she raising the TV remote in the air.

In a small bedroom in bright morning light, a young woman with messy blonde hair and a white T-shirt lies asleep on a white pillow. Beside the bed a round silver alarm clock with two bells stands on a wooden chair used as a bedside table, on a newspaper next to a book and a glass of water. She lifts her head, sits up half-asleep and swings her arm down towards the clock, knocking the book off, then drops back onto the pillow and sleeps again. A chest of drawers and a window with thin curtains are behind her.

A young woman with messy dark hair, a grey T-shirt and heavy fireproof trousers with red braces stands inside a fire station at night. She swings her padded fire jacket over her shoulders, pushes her arms into the sleeves and pulls it on, then turns away while fixing her hair. Behind her, a red fire engine flashes its lights by the open door with rain falling outside, a firefighter slides down a brass pole, others in full gear stand by the truck, and a spotted Dalmatian dog walks across the floor.

A laughing young woman in a long navy coat walks up to her front door on a terraced street on a rainy evening, holding a black umbrella over her head and carrying brown paper shopping bags. A big fluffy brown and white dog in a yellow raincoat walks beside her and looks up at her. She reaches the step, takes out her house keys and unlocks the warm, glowing yellow door while the dog waits next to her. Lit windows, street lamps and wet paving stones fill the street behind them.

A young man with curly dark hair, a green T-shirt and rolled-up khaki trousers lies barefoot in a hammock slung between two huge redwood trees, with golden sunlight shining between the trunks. His eyes are closed and his head falls back as he drifts off. An open book slips out of his hanging hand and falls to the ground, and his empty arm keeps hanging over the side while he sleeps. A coiled rope lies on the forest floor among ferns.

On a hanging tent platform fixed to a sheer granite cliff, high above a sea of clouds at sunrise, a young woman climber in an orange down jacket, a bobble hat with a head torch and a harness eats breakfast. She takes a bite from her fork, then lifts a steaming mug and laughs. On her lap is a plate of toast, fried egg and baked beans. A black raven sits on the platform edge next to her, birds fly past, and ropes and a second platform hang nearby.

In a bright bedroom in the morning, a young woman in a long light-blue shirt and socks laughs as she flings a white sheet high into the air over a wooden bed, and a ginger cat leaps through the air under the billowing sheet. The sheet settles over the bed with the cat sitting on top, and she leans over the bed and smooths the sheet around the cat. A bearded man in a bathrobe stands in the doorway holding mugs and drinking, and a pillow lies on the floor by tall windows and potted plants.

Four stacked scenes show one young woman on the same concrete rooftop beside a metal water tank, with a town and the sea behind. At the top she sits in a green armchair sipping from a morning cup; next she lies stretched out in the chair in the bright midday light and lifts her sun hat; then she drinks from her cup in the golden afternoon light; and at the bottom she sleeps under a blanket at dusk with empty cups at her feet. A tabby cat sits on the wall in every scene and turns its head.

A steep cobbled street in an old city at dawn, the sky pink and the sun just coming up. The street lamps are still lit and the street is almost empty. A young man in a blue T-shirt and black shorts jogs towards the camera and then away up the street, waving to a young woman in a cream jumper and apron who is setting out the folded chairs of a café that is not yet open. She smiles at him, and a tabby cat sits beside her. Washing hangs from the balconies above.

A dim hallway at night with snow falling outside the window. A young woman with long dark hair, in a long brown coat, satin skirt and sequinned top, tiptoes barefoot along a patterned runner on the wooden floor, holding her black high heels in one hand. She glances towards an open doorway, then stops and covers her mouth with her hand. Through the doorway a man sleeps on a sofa under a blanket and a brown spaniel lies on the floor. A small wall lamp gives a warm light.

A bedroom at night with patterned green wallpaper and a crescent moon in the dark window. A smiling young woman in pink pyjamas sits on the edge of her bed winding a small brass alarm clock, puts it on the bedside table, then turns back and clenches her fists happily. A wetsuit hangs on the wardrobe, a surfboard leans against the wall, and a packed beach bag and a pair of flip-flops wait by the bed. A ginger cat sleeps on the mattress and a bedside lamp gives warm light.

A shirtless young man sits on wet rocks in front of a tall jungle waterfall, with a rainbow in the mist behind him. He rubs shampoo into his hair with both hands, and white foam runs down his chest as the water washes it away. He closes his eyes and smiles. Three monkeys sit on the rocks in front of him; one holds his shampoo bottle and another puts its hands on its head like him. With no bathroom nearby, he uses the waterfall to have a shower.
